sloka: अल्पापराधे काकुत्स्थ द्विजाभ्यां शाप ईदृशः ।महान्नृगस्य राजर्षेर्यमदण्ड इवापरः ।। ७.५४.२ ॥
transliteration: alpāparādhe kākutstha dvijābhyāṁ śāpa īdṛśaḥ ।mahānnṛgasya rājarṣeryamadaṇḍa ivāparaḥ ।। 7.54.2 ॥

translations.english: O Kakutstha, for a minor offense, such a severe curse was given by the two Brahmins, like another punishment from Yama for the royal sage Nṛga.
